claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 read 'Nikon D3100', not D610.

claims.claim: Comes with original battery and charger.
claims.evidence: Battery and charger inclusion are listed as not shown.
Shutter count is listed as not shown.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: Lens inclusion and condition are listed as not shown; lens cap is on.
Repair history is listed as not shown and cannot be proven by photos.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears.
claims.evidence: Report does not describe cosmetic condition.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or functions are faulty.
risks.proof: Video clip of camera turning on, navigating menus, and firing the shutter.

risks.risk: Shutter count is high or unknown.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count from the camera menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-wear with unknown actuations.

risks.risk: Sensor has dust, scratches, or dead pixels.
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor or a test shot of a white wall at small aperture.

risks.risk: Battery and charger are missing or dead.
risks.proof: Photo of the original battery and charger, or clip of battery holding a charge.

risks.risk: Lens is missing or has fungus or scratches.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens elements and mount, or lens included in the shot.

risks.risk: Camera has been repaired or is out of warranty.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly repaired and out of warranty.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Screenshot of the shutter count menu.
Photo of the lens front and rear elements.
Photo of the original battery and charger.
Repair or warranty documents if any.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon D3100, contradicting the seller's D610 claim, but the item is identifiable and can be priced at its worst case. Functions, accessories, and history are unproven and are listed as risks.
